name: localcad
description: Let Claude design 3D-printable parts in DraftOtter, the offline CAD app open in your browser.
long_description:
Connects Claude to DraftOtter running in your browser. Claude can read the design, add shapes and custom sketches, cut holes, use design variables, check its work with screenshots and print stats, and export STL, 3MF or STEP files. You see every change live in DraftOtter and can undo each one.

In DraftOtter, open More (wrench) → Connect Claude and tick "Allow Claude to connect". Everything stays on this computer: the extension only talks to DraftOtter over 127.0.0.1.

tools.name: get_design
tools.description: The open design: its name, printer bed size, variables, the current selection, and the object tree (id, name, type, hole, group mode, parameters, pos/rot/scale, color, and the world-space bounding box of each object).

tools.name: list_shape_types
tools.description: The shapes add_shape can create (box, cylinder, gear, thread, screw holes, …) with their parameters: key, label, default, type and allowed options.

tools.name: sketch
tools.description: Create (or, with id, replace the profile of) a custom shape from a 2D profile drawn in the sketch XY plane.

tools.name: update_object
tools.description: Change an object: parameters (only the ones given change), name, color, hole, visibility, position, rotation, scale, or a group's mode.

tools.name: move
tools.description: Move objects in world space: by an offset, and/or drop them onto the bed, and/or center them on the bed.

tools.name: ungroup
tools.description: Split a group back into its objects (they keep their places).

tools.name: delete_objects
tools.description: Delete objects (the user can undo it).

tools.name: set_variables
tools.description: Set design variables (numbers or expressions of other variables, e.g.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Size, volume, weight (at 100% infill), surface area, center of mass, triangle count and print warnings, for the given objects or the whole visible design.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Render the design (or just frame some objects) from a standard view and return the image, to check your work.

tools.name: select
tools.description: Select objects in DraftOtter so the user sees which ones you mean (an empty list clears the selection).

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo (or with redo: true, redo) the last changes in DraftOtter.

tools.name: export
tools.description: Export objects (default: the whole visible design, holes cut) to a file for printing: STL, 3MF or STEP.

port.title: Port
port.description: Port DraftOtter connects to (the same as in DraftOtter → Connect Claude → Advanced).

export_dir.title: Export folder
export_dir.description: Where files that Claude exports (STL, 3MF, STEP) are saved when no full path is given.
